name: Cash Deposit Request V 01
definition: The CashDepositRequest message is sent by a cash sender to a cash receiver to request that cash can be delivered for deposit into an account.

GroupHeader.name: Group Header
GroupHeader.definition: Set of characteristics shared by all individual notifications included in the message.

CashDepositRequest.name: Cash Deposit Request
CashDepositRequest.definition: Specifies the details of a cash deposit request.

SupplementaryData.name: Supplementary Data
SupplementaryData.definition: Additional information incorporated as an extension to the message.
